name: PivotalPath Composite EW Index
abstract: The PivotalPath Equal Weighted Composite Hedge Fund Index is a global, equal-weighted index tracking over 1,300 institutional quality funds, spanning more than $2.3tn in AUM, covered by firm research. The constituent funds report monthly performance, net of all fees, in USD.  The index is rebalanced monthly, and the constituents are determined on an annual frequency (at the end of each calendar year).  The Index is representative of hedge fund performance across all strategies and geographies with a minimum fund track record of 18 months and a minimum fund AUM of $50mm.

name: PivotalPath Credit:Convertible Bond Arbitrage Index
abstract: The PivotalPath Credit: Convertible Bond Arbitrage Hedge Fund Index is an equal weighted index which comprises funds that employ an arbitrage approach to investing in the convertible bond market. The Index tracks the monthly performance, net of all fees in USD, of its constituents with a minimum fund track record of 18 months and a minimum fund AUM of $50mm. name: PivotalPath Equity Market Neutral Index
abstract: The PivotalPath Equity Market Neutral Index is a global, equal-weighted index comprised of funds that have a (self-declared) low net exposure profile and recent performance to reflect that (3-year beta to S&P500 within the [-0.2,+0.2] range). This is a dynamic classification: while the index is rebalanced monthly, the constituents are determined on an annual frequency (at the end of each year).  The constituent funds report monthly performance, net of all fees, in USD. The Index is representative of hedge fund performance across all funds meeting the above criteria with a minimum fund track record of 18 months and a minimum fund AUM of $50mm.

name: PivotalPath Event Driven:Equity Special Situations Index
abstract: The PivotalPath Event Driven: Equity Special Situations Hedge Fund Index is an equal weighted index which comprises funds that target investments in securities based on “special situations” that most commonly arise out of corporate spin-offs, mergers & acquisitions, bankruptcy, distress, litigation, activism, or any other complex scenario that the market may not easily price. The Index tracks the monthly performance, net of fees in USD, of its constituents with a minimum fund track record of 18 months and a minimum fund AUM of $50mm. name: PivotalPath Event Driven:Merger Arbitrage Index
abstract: The PivotalPath Event Driven: Merger Arbitrage Hedge Fund Index is an equal weighted index which comprises funds that typically purchase shares in one company and short sell the assets in another. The strategy is generally used in the expectation of a pending announcement of a company takeover, where the fund will take a long position in the target firm and a short position in the acquiring firm. The Index tracks the monthly performance, net of fees in USD, of its constituents with a minimum fund track record of 18 months and a minimum fund AUM of $50mm. name: PivotalPath Managed Futures:Non-Trend Index
abstract: The PivotalPath Managed Futures: Non-Trend Index is an equal weighted index of funds that typically trade volatility, mean reversion and other non-trend strategies to determine whether to invest long or short in futures contracts across metals, grains, equity indices and soft commodities, as well as foreign currency and U.S. government bond futures. The Index tracks the monthly performance, net of fees in USD, of its constituents and is representative of funds with a minimum fund track record of 18 months and a minimum fund AUM of $50mm. The constituents are fixed at the end each calendar year for the following calendar year.

name: PivotalPath RV Index
